fallacy_scan_11_of_11.1_measurement_validity: Normalized lifetime is only a chronological proxy.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.2_population_scope: One condition and five bearings; no broad population claim.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.3_independence: Samples within a bearing are dependent; bearing is the evaluation unit.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.4_sample_size: Only two evaluation bearings; report per-bearing results, not significance.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.5_missing_data: No missing latent rows detected after selected-bearing filtering.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.6_multiple_testing: One predeclared signed-axis comparison; no p-value search.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.7_effect_size: Report rho, backward fraction, balanced accuracy, MAE and R2.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.8_uncertainty: Insufficient independent bearings for reliable confidence intervals.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.9_model_assumptions: PCA assumes a common linear direction; failure does not reject nonlinear structure.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.10_leakage: Axis and mappings use only Bearing1_1-1_3; evaluation bearings supply local early reference only.
fallacy_scan_11_of_11.11_causation: Association with time does not establish physical damage causation.
